name: Build a daily dependency watcher with LangGraph and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore web search
title: Build a daily dependency watcher with LangGraph and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore web search
summary: The Web Search API in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore gives agents current, cited web results signed with the AWS credentials they already use. In this post, build a daily dependency watcher as a LangGraph graph that researches package ecosystems in parallel, keeps its rules in code, and checks every finding against its cited sources.
